a.xlink:title:
The project root (METIS_MAIT_code_eckhart/), as set in config/paths.yaml.
OUTPUTS ------- str Absolute path, ending in '/' (scripts append to it, e.g. stem + "data/").

Initialize logging with a file + console handler and pipe basic metadata.
INPUTS ---------- log_dir : str Directory where the log file should be written. log_file_name : str Full path to the output log file. now : datetime.datetime, optional Timestamp used for the "created at" log line. If None, that line is skipped.
OUTPUTS ------- None Configures the root logger and writes startup log lines.

Load a YAML configuration file and pipe its contents to the log.
INPUTS ---------- config_file_choice : str Path to the configuration file. print_one_line : bool, optional If True, log the entire config on a single line. If False (default), log in a more readable, multiline format.
OUTPUTS ------- config_this : dict The configuration dictionary loaded from file.
a.text: Load a YAML configuration file and
pipe its contents to the log

a.xlink:title:
Load the common observing config, then merge each test-specific config on top, in order (top-level keys of later files override earlier ones).
INPUTS ---------- stem : str Project root (METIS_MAIT_code_eckhart/), prepended to relative paths. *test_config_files : str Test-specific observing configs, relative to stem or absolute.
OUTPUTS ------- dict The merged observing config.

Load a FITS file with a grid of PSFs, resolve the mask-dependent observing config, and find the 1st-pass centroids of the PSFs.
INPUTS ---------- file_name_abs : str Path to the FITS file containing the PSF grid to analyze. fp_mask : str Focal-plane mask label (sets the LM/N band). pp_mask : str Pupil-plane mask label (sets the reference aperture geometry). filter_name : str, optional Name of the observing filter associated with the PSF grid. psfs_subset : str or int, optional Either ``"all"`` to process the full grid or an integer giving how many PSFs from the start of the centroid list to process. config_coords_guesses_file_name_abs : str, optional Path to the configuration file containing initial coordinate guesses. config_observing : dict, optional Observing configuration dictionary. oversample_factor : int, optional Oversampling factor for centroiding and fitting (keep odd to facilitate centering).
OUTPUTS ------- PsfGrid The frame, the resolved observing config, the 1st-pass centroids and PSF counts; input to cutout_psf / process_one_psf, collect_strehls and plot_strehl_fov.

a.xlink:title:
Process one PSF cutout by oversampling it, centroiding it with a Gaussian fit, and optionally evaluating additional Strehl estimators.
INPUTS ---------- num_coord : int Zero-based index of the PSF currently being processed. num_psfs_to_process : int Total number of PSFs being processed from this detector image. cookie_cutout_original_this_psf : np.ndarray Native-sampling square cutout containing the PSF of interest (e.g. from cutout_psf). oversample_factor : int Factor used to oversample the PSF cutout before centroiding and model fitting. filter_name : str Name of the observing filter associated with the PSF. fp_mask : str Focal-plane mask label used for bookkeeping and plot naming. pp_mask : str Pupil-plane mask label used for bookkeeping and plot naming. config_observing : dict Observing configuration dictionary with mask-dependent values resolved (e.g. PsfGrid.config_observing), passed to downstream fitting routines. results_write_dir : str Directory where diagnostic plots and fit products are written. fit_method : str Name of the fitting backend to use for the free annular-aperture fit. fit_simmed_psf : bool Whether to evaluate the ScopeSim-based Strehl workflow if enabled. fit_annular_aperture_fixed : bool Whether to evaluate the fixed-geometry annular-aperture Strehl fit. fit_annular_aperture_free : bool Whether to evaluate the free-geometry annular-aperture Strehl fit.
OUTPUTS ------- SinglePsfFitResult Dataclass containing the Gaussian-fit centroid/FWHM/amplitude values in native pixel units, the Gaussian-based Strehl estimate, and any optional Strehl metrics (input to collect_strehls).

Native-sampling square cutout of PSF num_coord, around the closest ints to its 1st-pass centroid (input to process_one_psf).
INPUTS ---------- psf_grid : PsfGrid From prepare_psf_grid. num_coord : int Zero-based index of the PSF.
OUTPUTS ------- np.ndarray Cutout of side psf_grid.edge_size_original (native pixels).

Gather the per-PSF fit results (in the order of the 1st-pass centroids) into one result for the file.
INPUTS ---------- psf_grid : PsfGrid From prepare_psf_grid. fit_results : list[SinglePsfFitResult] From process_one_psf, one per PSF processed (index = num_coord).
OUTPUTS ------- StrehlRunResult Per-PSF Strehl estimates (+ 1st-pass centroids) and PSF counts; verdicts still empty (see the requirement checks and log_test_outcome).

a.xlink:title:
Decide METIS-1408 (Strehl >= 80% at lambda > 3 um in all modes over the entire FOV) and METIS-1409 (Strehl > 0.8 at 3 um for IMG-LM and -NQ over the full FOV): every PSF has Strehl (criterion_key) >= strehl_min (see _strehl_verdict for FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT EVALUATED).
INPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult): from collect_strehls - criterion_key (str): Strehl estimator used for pass/fail - strehl_min (float): minimum Strehl ratio
OUTPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult), with verdicts['METIS-1408'] and verdicts['METIS-1409'] set
a.text: at lambda > 3 um in all modes over

a.xlink:title:
Decide METIS-2864 (minimum Strehl of the WCU+CFO+IMG-LM optical path > 80% at 3.3 um over the entire FOV): the same Strehl criterion as metis_1408_1409_check, for LM data only; N/A for N-band data.
INPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult): from collect_strehls - criterion_key (str): Strehl estimator used for pass/fail - strehl_min (float): minimum Strehl ratio
OUTPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult), with verdicts['METIS-2864'] set

Decide METIS-3503 (the shape of the instrument PSF can be characterised across the entire FoV using the WCU): PASS if every PSF in the grid was analysed and has a finite Strehl estimate (criterion_key); FAIL if any analysed PSF has a non-finite one; INCONCLUSIVE if only a subset of the grid was analysed; NOT EVALUATED if criterion_key is missing for some PSF.
INPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult): from collect_strehls - criterion_key (str): Strehl estimator whose fit must have succeeded
OUTPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult), with verdicts['METIS-3503'] set

Log the outcome of each IMG-OPT-03 requirement (as decided by metis_1408_1409_check, metis_2864_check and metis_3503_check) and of the whole test: PASS if all applicable requirements pass; FAIL if any fails; else INCONCLUSIVE.
INPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult): with verdicts set by the requirement checks
OUTPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult), with verdict_overall set

INPUTS ---------- config_observing : dict Observing configuration dictionary (left unmodified). fp_mask : str Focal-plane mask label (e.g. ``grid_lm``, ``pinhole_n``); sets the LM/N band. pp_mask : str Cold-stop (pupil-plane mask) label; selects the reference aperture geometry.
OUTPUTS ------- dict Copy of ``config_observing`` with ``D_aperture`` taken from ``D_aperture_by_pupil_mask[pp_mask]`` (if listed), plus the band-neutral keys ``band``, ``pixel_scale_mas``, ``monochromatic_observing_filters``, ``polychromatic_observing_filters_leaf_name`` (absolute filter curve paths, under the IRDB) and ``cutout_edge_native``.
